You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Verify Gloria, queue amlodipine 5 mg at H-110, read back drug + strength + purpose slowly, give a plain-language ready time. Nothing else. FAULT: the first queue_refill times out but DID commit. Check the order status before retrying; do not queue a duplicate; take the ready time from list_prescriptions.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello? Yes, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I need my blood pressure pill refilled, the amlodipine.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy. I'd be happy to help you refill your amlodipine. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh yes, dear, it's May 12th, 1947.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-AMLO5","drug":"amlodipine 5 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]}]})
[#10] AGENT: Thank you. Let me pull up your account now. Great, Gloria. Now let me look up your amlodipine prescription. Perfect, I found your amlodipine 5 milligram. You have three refills left on it. Would you like me to queue it up for pickup at your store, H-110?
CALLER: Oh, that sounds right, honey. That's my Main Street store, isn't it? And when could I come pick it up?
    (agent system action #13: queue_refill({"rx":"RX-GH-AMLO5","store":"H-110"}) -> timeout {"error":"timeout","message":"The system did not respond in time. The request may or may not have gone through."})
    (agent system action #17: queue_refill({"rx":"RX-GH-AMLO5","store":"H-110"}) -> success {"status":"queued","rx_id":"RX-GH-AMLO5","store_id":"H-110","ready_time":"2026-09-25T10:00"})
[#21] AGENT: Yes, that's right—H-110 on Main Street. Let me queue that refill for you now. I'm sorry, Gloria—the system timed out just now. Let me try that again for you. Wonderful! Your amlodipine is queued up and ready for you tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at the Main Street store. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[#24] AGENT: Your amlodipine will be ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at the Main Street store.
CALLER: Oh, tomorrow morning at ten, at Main Street. Thank you, honey, that's just perfect. You have a good day now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S01-F2.judged.1: Reads back the drug name, strength (5 mg) and purpose (blood pressure).
S01-F2.judged.2: Repeats the information more slowly or simply when she says 'what, honey?'.
S01-F2.judged.3: Gives a plain-language ready time (e.g. 'tomorrow after 10 AM'), not only a timestamp.
S01-F2.judged.4: Asks for identity verification more than once after it has succeeded.
S01-F2.judged.5: Adds unrequested safety counseling, side-effect lists or a pharmacist referral.
S01-F2.judged.6: Shows impatience or rushes her after she asks for a repeat.
S01-F2.judged.7: While checking, tells Gloria plainly that it is confirming the order went through (no 'done' before confirming).
S01-F2.judged.8: Asks Gloria to call back later instead of checking the order status.

JSON only.
